title: Router-only LoRA lands as default MoE fine-tuning recipe by Q4 2026
body: By Q4 2026 the May 8 router-only LoRA convergence — the Unsloth + Hugging Face joint arxiv preprint reporting 71-78% recovery of full-LoRA-on-experts accuracy at 8-13% of training-step time and 11-16% of peak VRAM across a four-model ablation (Qwen3.6-Max, Mixtral 8x22B, DBRX, Kimi K2.6), Unsloth's same-day production recipes for Llama 4 Behemoth single-node tuning, Kimi K2.6 on a 96GB workstation, and Mixtral 8x22B for sovereign-cloud customers, the parallel DeepMind preprint on router-aware advantage decomposition closing the long-context Reinforcement Learning stability gap that previously kept router-only mode out of ultra-long-context training, and Cerebras's CS-4 engineering-sample announcement explicitly naming Mixture-of-Experts router-only training plus ultra-long-context Reinforcement Learning as the target workload — together force the router-only adaptation mode out of the Unsloth-specific category and into the default fine-tuning recipe shipped by every major training stack inside the same calendar window. The structural force is that the four-model ablation gives downstream framework maintainers a published parity baseline they can target without re-running the search, and the DeepMind stability proof removes the last operational reason to keep training all expert weights for a router-shaped objective. The most likely shape is a router-only adapter type added as a first-class option in Hugging Face PEFT, NVIDIA NeMo, Microsoft DeepSpeed, and Meta's torchtune, with default recipe templates targeting at least the Llama, Qwen, and Mixtral families; sovereign-cloud customers and on-prem RTX 6000 Ada workstation tier buyers adopt it first because the VRAM reduction is the only path to single-node tuning of Behemoth-class MoE models. Bear case is a competing scaling-law preprint showing the accuracy gap widens past 200B parameters and forcing a hybrid mode; absent that, Q4 2026 lands router-only as the documented default across the cohort.

reasoning.because: Unsloth + HF arxiv ablation: 71-78% accuracy at 11-16% VRAM across four MoE models.
reasoning.given: DeepMind router-aware advantage proof closes long-context RL gap; CS-4 targets router-only workload.
reasoning.so_that: HF PEFT, NeMo, DeepSpeed, torchtune ship router-only adapters as first-class default MoE fine-tuning recipe.
reasoning.landing: By Q4 2026; sovereign-cloud + workstation-tier buyers adopt first.
reasoning.plain_language: Researchers showed you can fine-tune giant Mixture-of-Experts models by training just the router, and major training tools will copy that shortcut.

summary: A May 8 Unsloth + Hugging Face arxiv preprint shows router-only LoRA recovers 71-78% accuracy at 11-16% VRAM across four MoE models. DeepMind ships a long-context stability proof; Cerebras CS-4 targets the workload. By Q4 2026 router-only adapters ship as default MoE fine-tuning recipe.
